propositions: Test fails intermittently when two concurrent writers race on a shared git index; the second writer's commit becomes a no-op because the first writer's bare commit already staged both files.
Worker assertion reports only stderr and lacks command name and stdout, making failures undiagnosable; git commit -q writes 'nothing to commit' to stdout and leaves stderr empty.
Advisory lock is held per run_git_write call, but worker add and commit are two separate calls and not serialized as a pair, allowing an interleaving where both files end up in one writer's commit.
Test requires both concurrent writers through run_git_write to exit 0 and both commits to land in git log, but current design allows one commit to be empty.
Fix changes each worker to commit its own pathspec instead of the whole index, ensuring each writer has its own change to commit regardless of add/commit interleaving.
